fix(postgres): fence lease release replay

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-53
  description: |-
    Require a non-held runnable-lease release replay to match the requested generation and the immediately preceding version fence before returning AlreadyReleased. Add PostgreSQL acceptance coverage for generation 1 release, generation 2 reacquisition and release with reused evidence, and a stale generation 1 replay that leaves the generation 2 projection unchanged.
